subject: general
question: In the electrolytic refining process of metals, electrolyte is made up of which of the following?

options.text: Combination of pure metal and metal salt

solution:
The correct answer is __**Metal salt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the electrolytic refining process, the **electrolyte** used is a solution of **metal salt**.
 
• This solution contains ions of the metal that is being refined.
 
• The impure metal is made the anode, and a thin sheet of pure metal acts as the cathode.
 
• During the process, **metal ions** from the electrolyte deposit on the cathode, while impurities are left behind at the anode.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrolytic Refining:**

 
 
• It is a method used to purify metals by using electrolysis.
 
• Commonly refined metals include copper, zinc, aluminum, and nickel.
 
• The process ensures the removal of impurities and the production of high-purity metal.
 
 
 
• **Anode Mud:**
 
 
• The residue left behind at the anode during electrolytic refining is known as anode mud.
 
• Anode mud can contain precious metals like gold and silver, which can be recovered separately.
 
 
 
• **Cathode and Anode:**
 
 
• The cathode is the electrode where reduction (gain of electrons) takes place.
 
• The anode is the electrode where oxidation (loss of electrons) occurs.
 
 
 
• **Electrolyte:**
 
 
• The electrolyte is a conducting solution that allows the flow of ions during electrolysis.
 
• In electrolytic refining, the electrolyte is typically a solution of the metal salt corresponding to the metal being refined.
